sources.what: Official residential price plan page, read in the built-in browser 26 Oct (plan cards, w/GST and w/o GST)
Keppel plan feed the page loads; used only for FIXED24 Special (referral-only, not shown as a card)
EMA fact sheet PDFs (deposit and termination sections)

plans.name: FIXED24

promo.title: Bill rebate + Maybank card rebate
promo.value: S$125 bill rebate + S$20 Maybank card rebate = up to S$145

plans.notes: Unchanged on the page and in the plan feed (26 Oct); same fact sheet version as last week.
plans.evidence: FIXED24 24 Months Fixed Rate 30.90¢/kWh (w/GST) Fixed Rate 28.35¢/kWh (w/o GST)

terms.deposit_source: Security Deposit (see footnote 7): Deposit will be billed via the first invoice as follows: Security Deposit ($) All New Sign-ups HDB 1/2 50 HDB 3/4/5/EA/Jumbo 90 Condo/HDUC/EC 120 Others (e.g. shophouse) 190 Landed 220
terms.etf_source: Early Termination Charge (see footnote 6): Early termination charges: A x B x 30% where: A = the number of complete days remaining in the Initial Term under such Agreement after the date on which such Initial Term terminates pursuant to the terms of such Agreement; and B = the arithmetic average of the Charges payable in respect of each day by the Consumer to the Retailer under such Agreement during the period of the latest 2 months immediately preceding the termination.
